summary: Iteration 57 — Full backend+frontend validation of MamanDouce v10.4 'Scanner IA + UI fixes'. Backend: 7/7 pytest tests PASS on real preview URL (Scanner IA categories list, menu analysis with real generated JPEG returns items[] with nom_du_plat/prix/categorie, facture analysis returns fournisseur/date/articles/total_ttc, invalid category → 400, missing image → 400, history endpoint, plus iteration-55 birth_list_item contribution regression). Frontend: /scanner-ai shows 8/8 category bubbles with data-testids, violet ring activates on selection, Prendre une photo + Importer buttons + 2 hidden file inputs all render. /tracking renders ONE unified card per category (data-testid weight-chart contains 'Poids actuel'+'Prise de poids'+'Courbe de poids'+rose-bonbon Ajouter; data-testid baby-chart contains 'Poids estimé'+'Taille'+'Croissance du bébé'+rose-bonbon Ajouter). Add-weight form opens with weight-input + Enregistrer (btn-rose-bonbon) + Annuler (btn-rose-bonbon-outline). Home SA badge: with localStorage.mamandouce_pregnant=true + future due_date, data-testid='sa-pregnancy-badge' renders text '🤰SA 23' and clicking navigates to /cycle-tracking as expected. Postpartum bubble cycle borders verified: /securite has logo-bubble-yellow + logo-bubble-blue; /soins same; /alimentation has yellow+blue+red+green. NO regressions, NO new console errors beyond pre-existing 401 'Erreur chargement layout' + 404 resource fetches carried from iter 55-56.
action_items: Pre-existing (not from this iteration): 401 'Erreur chargement layout' fires before auth context is ready on /auth, and several 404 resource fetches (manifest/icon). Worth a separate cleanup pass.
critical_code_review_comments: Scanner IA route is well-isolated, uses the official OpenAI SDK (chat + vision, gpt-4o), strips markdown fences, falls back to {error:'json_parse_failed',raw_response:...} when JSON parsing fails — robust.
scanner_ai.py persists history with _id excluded on read (find projection {_id:0}) — good. user_email duplicated in scanner_history doc but excluded on output — acceptable.
ScannerAIPage.js compressImage uses HTMLCanvas to JPEG q=0.85 max 800x600 — typical output 50–200 KB base64, matches spec.

TrackingPage merges stats+chart+button into a single Card per category exactly as required; both Ajouter buttons carry .btn-rose-bonbon and the inner Enregistrer/Annuler buttons carry .btn-rose-bonbon and .btn-rose-bonbon-outline respectively.
SAPregnancyBadge correctly returns null when mamandouce_pregnant !== 'true' OR mamandouce_due_date missing (confirmed by the SA badge not rendering before localStorage was seeded).
seed_data_creation: Two synthetic JPEG images generated in-memory via PIL (menu card + invoice card) with real text, edges and shapes per /app/image_testing.md. Also one TEST_-prefixed birth_list_item contribution submitted via /api/contributions/submit (cleanup-tagged).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth uses data-testid='email-input', 'password-input', 'submit-button'. Login is /auth (not /login). After login dismiss popups Non, plus tard / C'est parti / Passer. SA badge requires localStorage 'mamandouce_pregnant'='true' AND 'mamandouce_due_date'='YYYY-MM-DD' (future). Scanner IA testid prefix: scanner-category-{id}, scanner-take-photo, scanner-upload, scanner-analyze-btn (only after preview set), scanner-add-field, scanner-share-btn. TrackingPage testids: weight-chart, baby-chart, add-weight-btn, add-baby-btn, weight-input, baby-weight-input, baby-size-input. For backend Scanner IA tests use the PIL-generated JPEGs in /app/backend/tests/test_scanner_ai.py — they reliably produce confidence > 0.5 on gpt-4o.
rca_of_the_issue: Not applicable — all features verified working end-to-end.
